elements.description: Orange stamina value/bar directly below the player portrait.

elements.success_evidence: same-frame OCR value and orange occupancy associated with the portrait
elements.failure_or_busy_evidence: unreadable value, overlay, resource refill dialog, or unexpected color family
elements.recovery_reset_behavior: close named non-cost detail only; otherwise return to canonical town home and reacquire
